chunks: 2480 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission; he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:

Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves gentleness and aids in it. So when you ride lean animals, let them stop at their stopping-places. If the land is barren, then hasten on them; and if it is fertile, then let them stop at their stopping-places.

key_terms.الدَّوَابَّ: riding animals or beasts used for travel
key_terms.مُخْصِبَةً: fertile, verdant, or rich in pasture

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about kindness and proper treatment of riding animals in travel?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches gentleness and proper care toward riding animals, linking such conduct to what Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves. It instructs riders to consider the condition of both the animals and the land, moving quickly through barren terrain and allowing rest when pasture is available.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2480 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, loves gentleness and facilitates it. When you ride lean animals, grant them proper rest. If the land is barren, travel quickly on them. If the land is fertile, let them rest in appropriate places."
